text:
Anya (support): customer (org: acme-corp, id: org_92f) opened a ticket — their console shows negative tokens/sec and long zero windows for streaming TTFT since ~03:15 UTC. Billing flagged ~+14% token usage last hour vs actual traffic. Screenshot: https://files.internal/redacted.png

Michael (eng-metrics): can you paste the exact dashboard link and a sample window timestamp?

Anya (support): https://console.redwood/metrics/org_92f/streaming?range=1h
Example bad window: 2024-08-04T03:20:00Z -> tokens/sec = -312.
Billing alert id: BILL-1137. Customer says API latency is normal.

Shreya (ingest): thanks. tagging @Eva and @ops-oncall. My first guess: rollup aggregator emitted negative deltas after a partial replay/partition rebalance. Any recent deploys to rollup-aggregator?

ingest-bot: rollup-aggregator-v2 deployed at 2024-08-04T02:58:12Z (sha: b3f7a2c). Consumer group "rollup-agg" experienced a rebalance at 2024-08-04T03:14:53Z.

Eva (sre): noted. I'm pulling consumer lag + commit logs. Running quick checks:
```
# check consumer lag
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --group rollup-agg --describe
# sample clickhouse query for rollup window
SELECT window_start, sum(tokens_delta) as tokens FROM streaming_rollups WHERE org_id='org_92f' AND window_start >= '2024-08-04 03:00:00' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start
```

Michael (eng-metrics): also run the normalization step check — we've seen negative values when ingestion timestamps are out-of-order and the rollup tries to compute delta against a later checkpoint. Look for out_of_order_count > 0 in the last hour.

Shreya (ingest): I ran a narrow query and pasted results:
```
2024-08-04 03:18:00Z, tokens_delta = -312
2024-08-04 03:19:00Z, tokens_delta = 0
2024-08-04 03:20:00Z, tokens_delta = -48
```

Anya (support): customer insists they saw normal requests; they provided an example request id: req_9832a. Can we correlate?

Michael (eng-metrics): grabbing event trace for req_9832a — looks like request processed at 2024-08-04T03:17:43Z by pool-dedicated-11, tokens produced 1,024. No sign of negative token accounting at runtime. So likely post-processing/aggregation issue.

Eva (sre): consumer rebalance at 03:14 aligns with onset. Hypothesis: aggregator reprocess/repair restarted and replayed some older offsets out of order. Two likely causes: (1) timestamp skew between producers and rollup processor (NTP drift) or (2) duplicate/late messages with older timestamps overwriting newer checkpoints.

Shreya (ingest): checking producer timestamps and commit log ordering. Found a small cluster of messages with event_ts older than ingestion_ts by ~5m from pool-dedicated-11 — looks like the model runtime clock had drifted on that host during a short window.

ops-oncall: indicating impact: negative deltas only appear in metrics rollup, not raw logs. No user-facing API errors confirmed. Billing impact depends on rollup -> invoices use aggregated tokens/sec windows for quota enforcement; need to avoid charging customers for negative or double-counted tokens. Setting priority: P2 for correctness + billing review.

Michael (eng-metrics): propose immediate mitigation: clamp negative rollup deltas to 0 during rollup emission and mark windows with validation flag so console hides/treats as stale. Longer term: we should backfill corrected rollups and re-run billing delta for the affected hour.

Shreya (ingest): quick fix deployed: rollup-aggregator will now apply clamp in-memory (v2.1.4-hotfix) — limiting side effects. Patch rolled to 3/4 replicas at 03:52 UTC.

ingest-bot: rollup-aggregator-v2.1.4-hotfix rolled to replicas [a,b,c] at 2024-08-04T03:52:10Z.

Anya (support): told customer: we deployed hotfix to prevent further negative spikes; we are investigating backfill and will update within 2 hours. They appreciated the rapid response. :thumbsup:

Eva (sre): next steps for postmortem/backfill:
1) identify all orgs with negative tokens_delta windows between 2024-08-04T03:10 and 2024-08-04T03:30 UTC.
2) for each org, compute corrected tokens by re-aggregating raw events ordered by event_ts and using monotonic checkpointing.
3) write corrected rollups to backfill table and trigger billing reconciliation for windows that affect invoices.

Michael (eng-metrics): I can run step 1 and produce a CSV. Quick query:
```
SELECT org_id, window_start, sum(tokens_delta) as tokens FROM streaming_rollups WHERE window_start >= '2024-08-04 03:10:00' AND window_start < '2024-08-04 03:30:00' AND sum(tokens_delta) < 0 GROUP BY org_id, window_start
```
I'm running it now, will paste results.

Michael (eng-metrics): paste:
```
org_92f,2024-08-04 03:18:00Z,-312
org_41c,2024-08-04 03:16:00Z,-24
org_9b2,2024-08-04 03:20:00Z,-80
```

Anya (support): added cases to the ticket queue and notified billing (billing@redwood). Billing asked for an ETA for reconciliation and whether affected customers will be credited automatically.

ops-oncall: we'll need to run the backfill during low-traffic window to avoid overload. Recommend staging backfill on canary for org_92f first. Shreya, can you own the backfill script?

Shreya (ingest): I will. Plan: run re-aggregation job for org_92f on canary, validate against raw events, then push to backfill_writer. Rough timeline: 90 minutes.

Anya (support): I'll update the customer: "we deployed a hotfix to stop new negative windows, we are running a targeted backfill for affected windows and billing will reconcile any over/under charges. ETA ~2 hours."

Eva (sre): monitoring dashboard set to alert if negative deltas reappear: alert-rule: streaming.rollup.negative_count > 0 for 2 windows -> pager.

Michael (eng-metrics): follow-up note: we should add a validation step to rollup emission that rejects back-in-time messages or attributes them to a 'late' bucket instead of applying to the active window. Filed ENG-ROLLUP-457.

Anya (support): customer confirmed they see numbers stabilizing post-hotfix, will await reconciliation. Closing loop after backfill + billing reconciliation. Thanks team.

ops-oncall: marking owner: Shreya (ingest). Incident tag: INC-2024-240-rollup-negatives.

Shreya (ingest): starting canary backfill for org_92f now. I'll post results and checksum when done.

Anya (support): thanks — will keep the customer updated. :white_check_mark:
